title: Senior .NET Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior .NET Full Stack Developer
Location: Austin, TX (Onsite)
Duration: 6+ months
Type: Contract

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Software Developer 3 to design, develop, and support enterprise applications for the Client The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in full-stack development using .NET Core, C#, React JS, SQL Server, Oracle, Power BI, and Microsoft Azure, with a strong background in modern web application development, cloud technologies, and Agile methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise web applications using .NET Core, C#, React JS, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, backend services, and responsive front-end applications.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases, stored procedures, views, and performance tuning.
  • Perform Oracle database development and legacy data migration to SQL Server.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports for business intelligence and operational reporting.
  • Develop, deploy, and support cloud-based applications using Microsoft Azure, including App Services, Storage, and security services.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, Git repositories, and DevOps practices for automated deployments.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and perform application maintenance, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, architects, UX designers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Prepare technical documentation, solution designs, and system architecture diagrams.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to coding standards and best practices.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release management.

Required Qualifications:

  • 11+ years of experience in full-stack application development using .NET Core, C#, React JS, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • 11+ years of experience with SQL Server, including data modeling, query optimization, performance tuning, stored procedures, views, and functions.
  • 11+ years of experience with Oracle, including legacy data migration to SQL Server and Oracle database development.
  • 11+ years of experience developing Power BI dashboards, paginated reports, and data transformation solutions.
  • 11+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, including application deployment, App Services, Storage, and security.
  • 11+ years of experience transforming and migrating legacy applications and data to modern web-based solutions.
  • 11+ years of experience converting legacy applications into web-based applications.
  • 11+ years of proficiency with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps tools.
  • 11+ years of experience performing Oracle data migration.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility standards.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience supporting large-scale IT systems in government or other regulated environments.
  • 8+ years of experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release activities.
  • 6+ years of experience working with Texas State agencies, healthcare, or public sector organizations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.

title: Senior IAM Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior IAM Engineer
Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid)
Duration: 12+ Months

Responsibilities:
  • The Software Developer III will design, implement and maintain an enterprise Identity and Access Management ecosystem over the life of the contract. Duties will include implementing the architectural design of a centralized identity provider framework using SAML 2.0 and IODC for SSO and MFA; building Joiner, Mover and Leaver lifecycle workflows; onboarding enterprise applications via REST APIs; and implementing Role-Based Access Control models.
  • Additional duties will include deploying a privileged access management solution featuring secure credential vaulting, automated password rotation, and just-in-time provisioning. Beyond initial deployment responsibilities, responsibilities extend to long-term system maintenance, including performance tuning, troubleshooting provisioning errors and connection failures, and continuing onboarding of business applications.

Required Skills:
  • IAM Platform governance, engineering, lifecycle automation and Scripting
  • Application onboarding, Integrate business applications with IAM systems
  • Designing and implementing RBAC models, enforcing separation of duties and designing certification campaigns
  • Managing Centralized Identity Provider and configuring SSO, MFA
  • Managing centralized identity providers, configuring SSO, MFA and federation protocols
  • SailPoint ISC implementation and operations

title: Oral Health Educator
description:
Job title : Oral Health Educator
Location: Indianapolis, IN (Hybrid)
Duration : 5+ Months Contract
Type : Contract

***** Initial interview will be via Teams with 2nd interviews requiring in-person attendance***

Short Description:
  • The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings.

Job Description:
Overview:
  • The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. This position will focus on equipping Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), school nurses, educators, children and families, and community partners with the knowledge and skills needed to support oral hygiene practices, preventive care, and improved oral health outcomes.

Responsibilities:
  • Training & Education: Develop and deliver tailored workshops, and training sessions for CNAs, school nurses, early learning centers, and community partners on oral health best practices.
  • Resource Development: Create and distribute educational materials such as guides, checklists, pamphlets, posters, videos, and digital content tailored to skilled nursing facilities, school settings, and families.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) leadership, school administrators, healthcare professionals, and community organizations to align ora health education with patient care protocols, school health needs, and communitybased initiatives.
  • Oral Health Advocacy: Promote the importance of oral health in overall health, especially for elderly residents, chronically ill patients, children, and vulnerable populations.
  • Support & Guidance: Serve as a resource to CNAs, school nurses, educators, and community partners by providing ongoing support, answering questions, and offering solutions to oral health challenges.
  • Outreach & Events: Support planning, coordination, and participation in community outreach events, health fairs, school-based programs, and public health campaigns to expand oral health awareness and access.
  • Program Support: Assist with program planning, preparation and distribution of oral health education materials, grant proposals, budgets, data collection, and reporting.
  • Evaluation: Monitor and assess the impact of educational programs and outreach activities and recommend improvements to enhance care delivery, school-based prevention, and community engagement.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree or certification in Dental Hygiene, Public Health, Education, or a related field.
  • Experience delivering health education or training programs, preferably in school, healthcare, long-term care, or community settings.
  • Knowledge of oral hygiene practices, common dental conditions, preventive care strategies, and behavior change techniques.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage CNAs, school nurses, healthcare teams, educators, families, and community partners.
  • Ability to develop accessible, engaging, and culturally appropriate educational materials.
  • Familiarity with skilled nursing facility workflows, school health programs, and public health outreach preferred.
  • Relevant background in public health, data management, program evaluation, and grant writing preferred.

Skills:
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to engage with CNAs, school nurses, administrators, healthcare teams, and community stakeholders.
  • Ability to present complex oral health information in a clear, accessible, and impactful manner.
  • Empathy and understanding when addressing oral health challenges in vulnerable populations.
  • Organizational skills to manage multiple training sessions, outreach activities, and program responsibilities.
  • Creativity in developing materials and presenting oral health information in an engaging way.
  • Proficiency in data management and analysis to support program evaluation and reporting.
  • Flexibility to support oral health education needs across long-term care, school, early learning, and community settings.
  • Relevant background in public health.
  • Prior experience with grant writing preferred.
